interpretation.preregistered_result: Three of five deployments passed the frozen v1.1 verifier: Qwen 3.8, Ornith and Muse Glimmer.
interpretation.posthoc_audit_result: A deterministic counterexample derived directly from candidate-visible requirement 4 invalidated Qwen 3.8 as a fully verified task solution. Ornith and Muse Glimmer remain successful under the expanded audit; this two-of-five figure is post-hoc and not a replacement preregistered score.
interpretation.artifact_contract_finding: The whole-file contract removed the v1 transport floor: four visible candidates were installable and reached tests, compared with zero applicable patches in v1.
interpretation.verifier_finding: Passing a frozen deterministic suite is only as strong as its behavioral coverage. The discovered start-cursor cycle gap is a concrete silent-failure example and requires a new verifier version rather than mutation of v1.1.
interpretation.model_finding: Ornith was the fastest result with no known counterexample and reproduced its excluded smoke byte for byte. Muse Glimmer was also correct but substantially slower and more verbose. Qwen 3.6 reached the hidden suite but missed the exact page budget. GPT-OSS again emitted no visible artifact.
interpretation.next_experiment: Preserve this report, add the explicit start-cursor cycle to a separately versioned verifier, validate red-to-green controls, then decide whether fresh model attempts are needed before Track B.
interpretation.limits: One task and one fresh attempt per deployment do not estimate general coding capability, reliability or latency distributions. The additional audit was designed after candidate inspection and is reported separately from the frozen outcome.
